{{Mergeto|Viewport/Legends}}
[[File:Window.png|thumb|right|250px|Coruscant, as seen through the windows of the [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|High Council Chamber]]]]
'''Windows''' were transparent glass panes in use on houses<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were generally covered over by [[curtain]]s&mdash;or, alternatively, shutters&mdash;when the house's inhabitants did not want others looking inside their homes,<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> or when it was nighttime.<ref name="sp">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref> Some windows were cleaned by [[CLE-004 window cleaning droid/Legends|CLE-004 window cleaning droids]].<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids" />

There were trillions of windows on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="ROTS novel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> most of which were composed of [[clari-crystalline]] or [[Glass/Legends|glass]] rather than more durable [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]], and thus, breakage was common.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids" /> The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] and [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]] leapt from a third-story [[Casino/Legends|casino]] window after a failed attempt to acquire the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on [[Nil Posondum]].<ref name="TMA">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref>
